usageNotes: Use this to inspect the IP-VRF routing entry that Proxmox SDN has programmed for an EVPN zone on a specific remote node — useful for verifying that BGP EVPN route advertisement is correct after zone or VNet changes. The target zone must be of type EVPN; calling this against a non-EVPN zone will return an error. The returned route shows where VRF traffic is being forwarded (nexthops) and which protocol installed it (typically BGP).

examples.summary: Retrieve the IP-VRF route entry for EVPN zone 'evpn-prod' on node 'pve1' of remote 'hetzner-de'

tips: The 'protocol' field indicates how the VRF route was learned — a value other than 'bgp' may indicate an EVPN control-plane issue.
An empty or missing nexthops array suggests the VRF interface is not up or BGP peering for this zone has not converged.
Cross-reference with SDN zone apply status to confirm the zone config has been pushed to FRR before interpreting results.
